why: Both confirm the same hedgehog and refuse Halvard Six and the student brand, but Analysis 2 leads with the key's central brutal fact (growth must come from share in a ~2% market, so such proposals will keep returning) and spells out the non-negotiable core disciplines. Analysis 2 is also better calibrated: it correctly says margin was in the 24–29% band in ten of the last eleven years where Analysis 1 overstates this, and it notes the proposal gives no operating margin.
